units.title: Academic Vocabulary / Léxico académico

grammar.explanation_es: En registro académico se usan conectores formales (furthermore, consequently) y nominalización para sonar objetivo.
examples: The findings are significant; furthermore, they are replicable.
Consequently, the hypothesis was rejected.
Nevertheless, further research is required.
The data imply a strong correlation.
This framework underlies the entire study.

story.text: The study presents a ___ analysis of the data. ___ , the results suggest a strong correlation. The authors ___ that the findings are robust. ___ , they acknowledge certain limitations. Further research is ___ to confirm the conclusions.

sentences: Consequently the hypothesis was rejected.
The data imply a strong correlation.
Nevertheless further research is required.
The findings are significant and replicable.

units.title: Complex Grammar / Gramática avanzada

grammar.explanation_es: Para enfatizar, invertimos sujeto y auxiliar: 'Not only did he win, but he also broke a record', 'Seldom have I seen such talent'.
examples: Not only did he win, but he also broke a record.
Seldom have I seen such talent.
Had I known, I would have helped.
No sooner had we arrived than it started to rain.
Under no circumstances should you give up.

story.text: ___ only is the report detailed, but it is also persuasive. ___ have I read such a compelling argument. ___ I known the deadline, I would have started earlier. No ___ had they finished than new issues arose. Were it ___ for her support, the project would have failed.

sentences: Seldom have I seen such talent.
Had I known I would have helped.
Not only did he win the prize.
No sooner had we arrived than it rained.

grammar.explanation_es: En debate formal matizamos (hedging) y concedemos puntos: 'Granted, that's true, but...', 'I would argue that...'.
examples: I would argue that education is the key.
Granted, the cost is high, but the benefits outweigh it.
On the contrary, the evidence suggests otherwise.
Let me play devil's advocate for a moment.
That said, we must bear the risks in mind.

units.title: Professional World / Mundo profesional

grammar.explanation_es: Para enfatizar: 'What we need is more time', 'It is efficiency that matters most'.
examples: What we need is a clearer strategy.
It is accountability that drives results.
What matters most is the outcome.
It was her leadership that saved the project.
What I suggest is that we streamline the process.

story.text: To ensure success, every ___ must be aligned on the goals. The team agreed to ___ the workflow to improve ___ . After reaching the first ___ , they renegotiated the project ___ to keep it feasible.

sentences: What we need is a clearer strategy.
It is accountability that drives results.
We must streamline the process.
The plan is feasible within the scope.

units.title: Nuance & Style / Matices y estilo

grammar.explanation_es: Matizar el grado de certeza: 'It may well be...', 'arguably', 'to a certain extent'.
examples: It may well be the best solution.
This is, arguably, his finest work.
The argument is compelling, albeit complex.
Notwithstanding the risks, they proceeded.
To a certain extent, I agree.

story.text: The author offers a ___ analysis that is ___ , though not without flaws. ___ the complexity, the central idea is easy to ___ . ___ , this book provides genuine ___ into human behavior.

sentences: It may well be the best solution.
This is arguably his finest work.
The argument is compelling albeit complex.
To a certain extent I agree with you.

vocabulary.es: Un mal que vino para bien

vocabulary.en: To take it with a grain of salt
To be in the same boat

grammar.explanation_es: Los modismos avanzados aportan naturalidad. Adáptalos al contexto formal o informal adecuado.
examples: Don't cut corners on safety.
The bottom line is that we need more time.
I'm still on the fence about it.
Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
Let's go the extra mile for our clients.

units.title: Abstract Concepts / Conceptos abstractos

grammar.explanation_es: Los sustantivos abstractos suelen ir sin artículo cuando son generales: 'Freedom is essential', 'Wisdom comes with age'.
examples: Freedom is a fundamental right.
Wisdom comes with experience.
Resilience helps us overcome failure.
Identity shapes our choices.
His legacy will endure.

story.text: True ___ is not the absence of fear but the courage to act despite it. Over time, ___ teaches us that failure builds ___ . A person of ___ treats everyone with respect, leaving behind a lasting ___ .

sentences: Freedom is a fundamental right.
Wisdom comes with experience.
Resilience helps us overcome failure.
His legacy will endure for years.

units.title: Arts & Literature / Arte y literatura

grammar.explanation_es: Cláusulas con participio para un estilo elegante: 'Written in 1925, the novel...', 'Praised by critics, ...'.
examples: Written in 1925, the novel remains relevant.
Praised by critics, the film won awards.
The author portrays society with subtle irony.
This metaphor enriches the narrative.
Its themes are universal.

story.text: The ___ is widely regarded as a ___ of modern literature. Its ___ are complex and deeply human. Through powerful ___ , the ___ explores themes of love and loss, inviting endless ___ .

sentences: The author portrays society with irony.
This novel is a true masterpiece.
Its themes are deeply universal.
The metaphor enriches the narrative.

units.title: Research & Analysis / Investigación y análisis

grammar.explanation_es: La investigación usa lenguaje cauto: 'The data suggest...', 'This may indicate...', 'It appears that...'.
examples: The data suggest a clear trend.
This may indicate a strong correlation.
The sample was relatively small.
These findings should be validated.
There are some limitations to consider.

story.text: The research followed a rigorous ___ to minimize ___ . After analyzing a large ___ , the team identified a significant ___ between the variables. The ___ were promising, although the authors noted several ___ .

sentences: The data suggest a clear trend.
The sample was relatively small.
These findings should be validated.
There are limitations to consider.

units.title: Register & Connotation / Registro y connotación

grammar.explanation_es: Para sonar diplomático usamos atenuadores: 'I'm afraid...', 'It might be better to...', 'with respect'.
examples: I'm afraid that won't be possible.
It might be better to wait.
He put it rather bluntly.
She handled it tactfully.
That's a bit of an understatement.

sentences: I'm afraid that won't be possible.
It might be better to wait.
She handled the issue tactfully.
He put it rather bluntly.

units.title: Collocations / Colocaciones

grammar.explanation_es: Los nativos combinan ciertas palabras: 'make a decision' (no 'do a decision'). Apréndelas en bloque.
examples: We need to make a decision soon.
Please pay attention to the details.
They reached a conclusion quickly.
This will have a huge impact.
Bear in mind the deadline.

sentences: We need to make a decision soon.
Please pay attention to detail.
This will have a huge impact.
Bear in mind the final deadline.

units.title: Global Issues / Temas globales

grammar.explanation_es: El registro periodístico usa frases nominales densas: 'the growing threat of climate-driven migration'.
examples: Inequality remains a pressing global issue.
The pandemic exposed weak infrastructure.
Diplomacy can prevent conflict.
Humanitarian aid reached the region.
Sustainability must guide development.

story.text: The international community faced a growing ___ as conflict forced thousands to flee. ___ organizations rushed to provide ___ to the ___ . Experts argued that long-term ___ , not just short-term relief, was essential.

sentences: Inequality remains a global issue.
Diplomacy can help prevent conflict.
Humanitarian aid reached the region.
Sustainability must guide development.

units.title: Advanced Verbs / Verbos avanzados

grammar.explanation_es: El registro culto exige verbos precisos: 'enhance' en lugar de 'make better', 'mitigate' en vez de 'reduce a bit'.
examples: The reforms enhanced productivity.
We must mitigate the risks.
She advocates for human rights.
Poor planning undermined the project.
The policy fostered innovation.

sentences: The reforms greatly enhanced productivity.
We must mitigate the financial risks.
She advocates for human rights.
Poor planning undermined the project.

units.title: Finance & Economics / Finanzas y economía

grammar.explanation_es: Relaciones causales formales: 'A leads to B', 'B stems from A', 'as a result of'.
examples: Rising inflation leads to higher prices.
The recession stemmed from weak demand.
Investors should diversify their assets.
The deficit widened significantly.
Markets remain highly volatile.

story.text: During a ___ , rising ___ erodes people's savings. Central banks may raise the ___ to stabilize prices. Wise investors ___ their portfolio to reduce risk, balancing each ___ against its potential return.

sentences: Rising inflation leads to higher prices.
Investors should diversify their assets.
The budget deficit widened sharply.
Markets remain extremely volatile.

units.title: Ethics & Philosophy / Ética y filosofía

grammar.explanation_es: Para argumentar en abstracto: 'One could argue that...', 'It raises the question of whether...'.
examples: One could argue that morality is subjective.
The case poses a serious ethical dilemma.
We must act with integrity.
Such actions are hard to justify.
Every choice has consequences.

story.text: The scientist faced a profound moral ___ : whether to publish data that could be misused. Guided by her ___ and a firm sense of ___ , she refused to ___ a decision that violated her core ___ .

sentences: One could argue that morality is subjective.
The case poses an ethical dilemma.
We must always act with integrity.
Such actions are hard to justify.

units.title: Rhetoric & Persuasion / Retórica y persuasión

grammar.explanation_es: Para enfatizar al persuadir: 'It is precisely because...', 'What is undeniable is that...'.
examples: What is undeniable is that change is needed.
Let me emphasize this key point.
Her argument was truly compelling.
He anticipated every counterargument.
This appeals to our sense of justice.

sentences: Let me emphasize this key point.
Her argument was truly compelling.
He anticipated every counterargument.
What is undeniable is the need to act.

units.title: Technology & Innovation / Tecnología e innovación

grammar.explanation_es: Para hablar del futuro tecnológico: 'will be using', 'will have transformed by 2040'.
examples: Automation will be transforming entire industries.
By 2040, AI will have reshaped work.
The startup developed a disruptive algorithm.
We need to optimize the infrastructure.
That technology is now obsolete.

story.text: The company achieved a major ___ with a new ___ that powered its product. Critics called the model ___ , predicting it would make older systems ___ . To grow, the team had to ___ its ___ for millions of users.

sentences: Automation will transform entire industries.
The startup built a disruptive algorithm.
We need to optimize the infrastructure.
That technology is now obsolete.

units.title: Advanced Phrasal Verbs / Verbos compuestos avanzados

grammar.explanation_es: Algunos phrasal verbs son válidos en registro formal: 'account for', 'bring about', 'stem from'.
examples: This factor accounts for the difference.
It all boils down to trust.
We cannot rule out that option.
The crisis brought about major change.
The problem stems from poor planning.

sentences: This factor accounts for the difference.
It all boils down to trust.
We cannot rule out that option.
The crisis brought about major change.

units.title: Legal Language / Lenguaje jurídico

grammar.explanation_es: El lenguaje legal usa 'shall' y 'be required to': 'The party shall comply with the terms'.
examples: The parties shall comply with the contract.
He was found liable for the breach.
The defendant filed an appeal.
This clause must be enforced.
The verdict was unanimous.

sentences: The parties shall comply with the contract.
He was found liable for the breach.
The defendant filed an appeal.
This clause must be enforced strictly.

units.title: Medicine & Health / Medicina y salud

grammar.explanation_es: Registro médico impersonal: 'The patient was diagnosed with...', 'Treatment is recommended'.
examples: The patient was diagnosed early.
Treatment significantly improved recovery.
The vaccine reduces severe symptoms.
Chronic conditions require ongoing care.
The drug has mild side effects.

sentences: The patient was diagnosed early.
Treatment improved his recovery.
The vaccine reduces severe symptoms.
Chronic conditions require ongoing care.

units.title: Academic Connectors / Conectores académicos

grammar.explanation_es: Conectores formales propios de ensayos y artículos: 'thereby', 'conversely', 'accordingly'.
examples: The data were incomplete; accordingly, conclusions are tentative.
Conversely, the second group improved.
Costs rose, thereby reducing profit.
This is notably absent from the report.
Henceforth, new rules apply.

sentences: Conversely the second group improved.
Costs rose thereby reducing profit.
This is notably absent from the report.
Accordingly the conclusions are tentative.

grammar.explanation_es: Estos modismos son frecuentes en contextos profesionales; úsalos para sonar natural y nativo.
examples: This product is a real game changer.
Their decision was a double-edged sword.
Let's think outside the box.
He got cold feet at the last minute.
They took the lion's share of the profit.
